texts.LongWelcomeMessage: Welcome to the application. This is a startup project based on the ABP framework. For more information, visit abp.io.
texts.Error:UnsupportedLanguage: Pick one of the portal's languages.
texts.Error:InvalidPhone: Type the phone number as 6 to 15 digits, optionally starting with +, for example +962790000000.
texts.Error:TranslationNameMissing: Type the {0} name, or remove that language.
texts.Error:WrongScript:Arabic: Use Arabic letters. Latin codes such as VIP may stay.
texts.Error:CloseBeforeOpen: Close hour must be after open hour.
texts.Error:UnknownTimeZone: "{0}" is not a known time zone. Use a name like Europe/Warsaw or Asia/Dubai.
texts.Error:InvalidWeekday: Closed days must be weekdays 0 (Sunday) to 6 (Saturday).
texts.Error:FloorNameMissing: Type a floor name or number.
texts.Error:SpaceTypeNameMissing: Give the space type a name.
texts.Error:SpaceTypeDuplicate: There is already a space type called "{0}".
texts.Error:SpaceTypeInUse:One: 1 space uses "{0}". Give it another type first.
texts.Error:SpaceTypeInUse:Many: {0} spaces use "{1}". Give them another type first.
texts.Error:SpaceBuildingMissing: Pick a building. Add one first if the list is empty.
texts.Error:SpaceFloorInvalid: Pick a floor that belongs to {0}.
texts.Error:SpaceDuplicate: Another space already uses that name.
texts.Error:SpaceTypeMissing: Pick a space type. Add one on the Space types page if none fits.
texts.Error:OpensEarlier:Floor: Floor cannot open earlier ({0}) than the building ({1}).
texts.Error:OpensEarlier:Space: Space cannot open earlier ({0}) than its floor ({1}).
texts.Error:ClosesLater:Floor: Floor cannot close later ({0}) than the building ({1}).
texts.Error:ClosesLater:Space: Space cannot close later ({0}) than its floor ({1}).
texts.Error:MinBelowParent:Floor: Floor's minimum duration cannot be less than the building's ({0}m).
texts.Error:MinBelowParent:Space: Space's minimum duration cannot be less than its floor's ({0}m).
texts.Error:MaxAboveParent:Floor: Floor's maximum duration cannot exceed the building's ({0}h).
texts.Error:MaxAboveParent:Space: Space's maximum duration cannot exceed its floor's ({0}h).
texts.Error:ScopeHasNoSpaces: That scope has no spaces to block.
texts.Error:StartEndRequired: Start and end are both required.
texts.Error:StartInPast: Start must not be in the past.
texts.Error:ClosedForHoliday: {0}'s building is closed for a holiday on {1}.
texts.Error:OutsideHours: {0} can only be booked between {1} and {2}.
texts.Error:DurationBelowMin: Minimum booking length here is {0} minutes.
texts.Error:DurationAboveMax: Maximum booking length here is {0} hours.
texts.Error:BuildingNotBookable: {0} is not bookable, so none of its spaces can be booked.
texts.Error:FloorNotBookable: {0} · Floor {1} is not bookable, so none of its spaces can be booked.
texts.Error:SpaceUnderMaintenance: {0} is blocked ({1}) from {2} and can't be booked then.
texts.Error:BookingConflict: The space is already booked for part of that window.
texts.Error:BookingSelfOverlap: You already have {0} booked from {1} to {2}.
texts.Error:OnlyOwnChange: You can only change your own bookings.
texts.Error:OnlyOwnCancel: You can only cancel your own bookings.
texts.Error:OnlyOwnEnd: You can only end your own bookings.
texts.Error:BookingLocked:ended: An ended booking cannot be changed.
texts.Error:BookingLocked:cancelled: A cancelled booking cannot be changed.
texts.Error:BookingInProgress: A booking that has started can only be cancelled or ended early.
texts.Error:VersionMismatch: This booking changed since you loaded it. Reload and try again.
texts.Error:BookingNotInProgress: Only a booking that has already started can be ended early.
texts.Error:EndedCannotCancel: An ended booking cannot be cancelled.
texts.Error:MaintenanceNotFound: No blocked time with that ID.
texts.Email:TestBody: This is a test email from Dixels Portal, sent at {0} (UTC). If you can read it, sending email works.
texts.Email:Hint:Disabled: Sending is switched off. Set ExchangeOnline.Enabled to "true" in the server's settings.
texts.Email:Hint:5.7.139: Microsoft 365 refused the sign-in. Check that SMTP AUTH is turned on for the service mailbox and the organisation, and that the tenant ID, client ID and client secret are right.
texts.Email:Hint:5.7.60: The sign-in worked but this address may not be used as the sender. Send from the service mailbox, or ask IT to give the app access to this address.
texts.Email:Hint:4.3.2: Too many connections at once. Queued emails are retried automatically; if it keeps happening, lower the sending rate.
texts.Email:Hint:5.2.0: The mailbox has reached a sending limit. Wait and try again, or ask IT to check the mailbox.
texts.Email:Hint:EntraId: Microsoft Entra ID refused the app's sign-in. Check the tenant ID, client ID and client secret (secrets expire), and that admin consent was granted.
texts.Email:Hint:Setting: A setting is missing or wrong; the message above names it.
texts.Email:Hint:Other: See the server reply, and the diagnostics section of docs/DEPLOYMENT.md.
